author: Jarkko Saltiola
name: http_server_currentfile
description: Runs a small built-in web page that reports which photo is currently open in darktable.
description-extensive: Runs a tiny web page inside darktable that tells a browser on the same computer which photo you currently have open. It's an experimental developer tool that needs the lua-http library installed via Luarocks, and should never be exposed to untrusted networks.
